verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਮ ਨੀਚ ਲਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: autam madham neech lakh gurmukh neechahu neech sadhaae|

en.bdb: Millions are low, medium and high but gurmukh calls himself low of the lowly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paa khaak hoi gurmukh gursikh aap gavaae|

en.bdb: He becoming dust of the feet and guru’s disciple erases his ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat bhau bhaau kar sevak sevaa kaar kamaae|

en.bdb: Going with love and respect to the holy congregation, he serves there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhe kai bhalaa manaae|

en.bdb: He speaks mildly, behaves humbly and even by giving something to somebody wishes good of others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi dharageh maan nimaanaa paae|

en.bdb: Absorbing consciousness into the Word that humble person receives honour in the court of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chalan jaan ajaan hoi aasaa vich niraas valaae|

en.bdb: Considering death as the last truth and becoming unknown to cunningness he remains indifferent to hopes and desires.
The imperceptible fruit of delight is seen and received only by Gurmukh.
